product_metadata.title: Wooden Coat Hanger 20 Pack, Heavy Duty Wood Clothes Hangers with 360° Swivel Hook, Suit Hanger with Notches & Non Slip Pants Bar for Jacket, Sweater, Camisole, Pants, Dresses, Shirts, Hoodie
features: 👗 MAXIMIZE YOUR CLOSET SPACE: HIPPIH heavy duty hangers with a sturdy construction, shoulder notch and non-slip pants bar, can be used in all clothing! All garments can be kept in place by easily hanging heavy blazers and matching slacks on the same hanger.

👗 STRONG BEARING STRENGTH: HIPPIH clothing hangers are made of sturdy, lightweight lotus wood with a sturdy 360-degree chrome hook that combines functionality and style. HIPPIH wood hangers construction is heavy duty and durable to your clothes, even for the heaviest one.
👗 EASY ON YOUR CLOTHES: HIPPIH dress hangers with a rounded, curved shoulder helps keep your clothes in shape. And the shoulder grooves make it easy to secure delicate strap vests and silky items.
👗 NON SLIP PANTS BAR: The pants bar of suit hanger is designed to grip and prevent creases, leave the pants in place and no longer wrinkle on the closet floor.
👗 PREVENT WRINKLES: HIPPIH wood clothes hangers prevent your pants or skirt from wrinkle or indentation. Useful sturdy wooden round pants bar can hang all kinds of clothes.
